name: Counties of Kenya
source: Constitution of Kenya 2010, First Schedule (Counties) [names]; IEBC, Registered Voters per County Assembly Ward for the 2022 General Election [codes]
notes: Codes 001-047 are the First Schedule order numbers, as used by IEBC (identical in both IEBC PDFs). Names follow the First Schedule as reproduced by the Kenya Law Reform Commission (klrc.go.ke); IEBC spells 006 as TAITA TAVETA and 013 as THARAKA - NITHI. as_of = date the Constitution was promulgated.
